total_weight.meaning: total gauge voting weight tracked by GaugeManager

emission_indexed.meaning: whether the minted emission tranche is accounted in the GaugeManager index rather than left orphaned on the contract balance

reward_pool_shrunk.meaning: whether the initial emissions remain orphaned and the reward pool is permanently shrunk

assumptions: Minter pulls newly minted HYBR into GaugeManager before the index update is evaluated.
The emission tranche is the initial emission distributed while totalWeight is zero.

unresolved.description: Report does not give the exact index/weight formula, so the indexed-accounting relation is represented by a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric index equation.

limitations: The claim formalizes only the reward_pool_shrinks impact; other listed impacts are not covered by this plan.
The indexed-accounting observable is a report-grounded Boolean because no numeric index formula is supplied.
